title: QR Code Generator
description: Create customizable QR codes instantly from URLs, text, or contact information. Processed 100% locally.
inputPlaceholder: Enter text or URL to encode
emptyInputError: Please enter some text or URL to generate a QR code.
generationFailedError: Failed to generate QR code. Please try again.
successMessage: QR code generated successfully! Downloading file.
downloadPrompt: If download does not start automatically, click here.

faq.a: Yes. Generation runs entirely inside your browser sandbox using the qrcode library. Your input text is never uploaded to remote servers.
You can encode website links (URLs), text messages, emails, Wi-Fi details, or phone numbers. Any alphanumeric string is supported.
